svg.title: Phase 6, Merge: four doors, then the merge and the bookkeeping
svg.desc: The merge method is refreshed: the setting, else the one method the repository allows, else the one its recent merged pull requests used, and mixed evidence asks you. Auto-approve merges on its own; attended, you are asked to merge or hold; unattended with auto-approve off, a converged status comment is posted and nothing merges. merge-pr then passes four doors in order and writes nothing when one refuses: the pull request must be open and not a draft; mergeable, or exit 5 sends the run back to base sync; free of migration files, or exit 4 hands you four checks to confirm; and clear of commits landed beside the reviewed hunks, or exit 6 shows the drift lines and any verdict for you to decide, an independent verdict on that same base merging on its own. The merge runs by the decided method with the head matched, the branch is deleted or kept with the reason, and the run records its statistics, drops the worktree, sweeps closed runs, and reports with its criteria signals.
svg.text: Every refusal writes nothing and names who decides. The merge is the one step that cannot be undone.
the orchestrating session sees one line per script

text.tspan: 2 commits landed, 1 files shared, level disjoint
Paxton-Meny/api#128 merged by rebase, branch deleted
run Paxton-Meny/api#128 outcome merged rounds 2 findings 5
worktree and context removed, ledger kept

auto-approve: it merges on its own
the pull request as it is now
by the method, the head matched

svg.text: or a PR bases on it

back to base sync, in Land
an independent verdict merges; else you
the line says which, and why

svg.text: a fallback, the run goes on
stops or parks; the number is the exit code
